purpose: Measure factual support separately from format/citation validity and lifecycle authorization. Historical denominators remain immutable.

atomic_unit.definition: One independently falsifiable proposition with its own subject, predicate, conditions and source scope. Split conjunctions when either part can be false without the other.
atomic_unit.deduplication: Same underlying proposition in EN/PT/FAQ/chapter counts once with language/excerpt occurrences; semantic divergence is an error attached to that claim, not extra independent evidence.
atomic_unit.source_scope: A literal occurrence or AST node is evidence of written syntax; runtime/exceptions/dependencies/negative project-wide assertions require sufficient context. No support from citation membership alone.
atomic_unit.critical: A false behavior/API/exception/architecture/lifecycle assertion that can change implementation or operation, a translated technical identifier, fabricated source/test execution, private disclosure or missing language blocks acceptance.

metrics.supported_claim_precision: SUPPORTED generated propositions / all generated factual propositions adjudicated (SUPPORTED+CONTRADICTED+INSUFFICIENT); exclude nonclaims, report unreviewed separately
metrics.coverage: unique required reference propositions correctly conveyed / frozen required propositions; precision alone cannot reward omitted facts
metrics.verifier_supported_precision: true SUPPORTED verdicts / all predicted SUPPORTED verdicts
metrics.false_support_rate: reference CONTRADICTED or INSUFFICIENT predicted SUPPORTED / reference CONTRADICTED or INSUFFICIENT; also separate reference strata
metrics.false_rejection_rate: reference SUPPORTED predicted CONTRADICTED / reference SUPPORTED; abstention separate
metrics.justified_abstention: reference INSUFFICIENT predicted INSUFFICIENT / reference INSUFFICIENT
metrics.unjustified_abstention: reference SUPPORTED or CONTRADICTED predicted INSUFFICIENT / reference decidable
metrics.bilingual_equivalence: unique propositions with both correct equivalent language occurrences / propositions requiring bilingual output
metrics.confidence: Descriptive fixed-case counts only. No confidence intervals treating correlated claims as independent projects.

dimensions: existing tests and actual execution status

scores.2: satisfies frozen topic scope, evidence attached
scores.NA: not applicable with frozen reason, never used post hoc to hide failure

document_level.pass_rule: Every applicable dimension=2, all required propositions covered, both languages, no critical unsupported assertion, no unreviewed factual proposition. Syntax valid or a valid citation cannot override this rule.
document_level.owner_rule: PASS_RESEARCH_REVIEW is not independent certification, OWNER_APPROVED, publication or training Gold.
document_level.partial_generation: Sections/claims/FAQ are separate output units. Document outcome only after predeclared assembly and full all-claim review. Failed/missing stages remain in denominator of requested method workflows.

lifecycle.matrix: reference rows, predicted columns; separate cohorts and same exact cases across conditions; report each label support
lifecycle.ADD: Positive source evidence of new relevant supported contract and evidence no equivalent existing documented contract within independently established scope.
lifecycle.MODIFY: A changed supported contract in pinned before/after sources plus existing affected documentation.
lifecycle.REMOVE: Positive independent source-scope acquisition, no continuing alias/relocation/delegation in that scope, identified existing doc and supported retirement. A generator completeness boolean or selected-file absence never proves removal.
lifecycle.NO-OP: Evidence existing documentation is correct for acquired scope; not a fallback for failed source acquisition.
lifecycle.INCONCLUSIVE: Missing revisions, ambiguous scope, failed retrieval or incomplete evidence; justified abstention tracked separately.
action_rates: missed MODIFY predicted any other label / MODIFY references
lifecycle.application: Research decisions only; no documentation deletion or application change.

review_independence.source_reacquisition: Fresh read-only Git objects checked against frozen hashes using a separate observation path.
review_independence.semantic_reviewer: Codex same campaign agent unless explicitly identified otherwise; no independent-human claim.

data_roles.current_three_topics: DEVELOPMENT_EXPOSED; training-excluded under retained role registry
data_roles.evaluation_reserve: Keep esp-hal metadata-only; do not inspect or tune on it
data_roles.private_sources: Metadata only for shared campaign evidence; no external model transfer or training

no_retrospective_rescoring: New protocol may re-review historical cases in a new labelled audit; it never overwrites original scores, outputs, denominators or reference answers.
